a.address_statement: The Busan Museum of Contemporary Art (MOCA Busan) is at 1191 Nakdongnam-ro, Saha-gu, Busan, on Eulsukdo Island, and its phone number is (051)220-7400, according to the city's visitor page.
a.notes: Source is the Busan city government site (busan.go.kr).
